title: Xyriel Manabat is Best Actress, Mono no Aware big winner of CinePanalo Film Festival 2026
summary: Kapamilya actress Xyriel Manabat was recognized as best actress in the full-length category of the 2026 Puregold CinePanalo Film Festival for her role in “Stuck on You.”
